description: This script sets up and manages a testing environment for SVN repositories with integration to Perl SVN libraries, including functions for starting SVN servers, converting data, and handling configurations.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Wraps the 'svn' command with optional custom configuration directory.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server for SVN if environment conditions are met.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Converts raw SVN data into a revision database format using Perl.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks if 'GIT_TEST_SVNSERVE' environment variable is enabled for running svnserve tests.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the svnserve daemon on a specified port and root directory.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Prepares and checks for UTF-8 locale support for testing.
